title: Birdeye Pricing & Plans | Review Management Software Pricing | Birdeye

facts.fact: Birdeye's pricing page reports 98.5K mobile Google Map impressions (vendor-reported statistic, no date given).
Birdeye's pricing page reports 15.3K reviews with a 4.6 star rating (vendor-reported statistic, no date given).

Birdeye states on its pricing page that its pricing is built around outcomes rather than seat counts, with one platform and one contract where customers pay only for what they deploy at their locations.
facts.quote: Pricing built around outcomes, not seat counts. One platform, one contract - replace point products and pay only for what you deploy at your locations

facts.fact: Birdeye's pricing request form offers location-count tiers of 1-3, 4-9, 10-39, 40-249, 250-999, and 1000+ locations.
facts.quote: 1-3 locations 4-9 locations 10-39 locations 40-249 locations 250-999 locations 1000+ locations
